title: Negative eigenvalue estimates for polyharmonic Schrödinger operators with measure-potentials: the subcritical case
summary: We study spectral estimates for polyharmonic Schrödinger operators $-Δ^l-μ$ in the subcritical regime $2l<\mathbf{N}$. The measure potential $μ$ is assumed to satisfy a capacitary smallness condition which guarantees that the corresponding operator is semibounded and self-adjoint. With such a measure $μ$ we associate an Otelbaev function, which reflects both the local concentration and the spatial distribution of the potential.
